nodes.label: ci.yml
nodes.summary: GitHub Actions CI workflow named "CI". Triggers on pushes to the main/master branches and on all pull requests. Defines a single "build" job running on ubuntu-latest that checks out the repo, sets up Node.js 20 with npm caching keyed on backend/ and frontend/ package-lock.json, installs backend and frontend dependencies via npm ci, and builds both the backend (npm run build:backend) and frontend (npm run build:frontend).
